category_title: Students who feel misunderstood and engage in off-task social behavior during tutoring
scenario_title: After-school math tutoring session with off-task social behavior
minimal_context: Beaumont is attending an after-school math tutoring session to copy class notes and complete his math work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Beaumont, it is time to start. Please take out your math assignment and copy the notes from class today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't have my math notebook with me. Let me just look through my backpack to find a pencil and some paper so I can get ready.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, please find what you need and begin.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I usually don’t know what is happening a lot during class anyway because I am kinda late usually or not paying attention. I learn differently.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to focus on the math work right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns to the student at the next desk) Hey, what are you working on? Look at this. I know I just have to stop messing around when I go, but I'm still preparing my stuff. My teacher doesn’t help the ones that are screwing around anyway – I get kicked out a lot [laughing].

task.content: Copying the same notes from the class, asking questions, and completing math work

context.environment: 30-45 minute math tutoring session in the after school program
context.social_setting: Peers working nearby, teacher available but usually spending her time with students doing actual work

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When arriving at tutoring and needing to begin actual work
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Rarely had the materials he needed to participate and usually spent that time 'preparing' to work. He was often off-task, interacting with his friends as they worked, inevitably pulling them off-task as well.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Considers himself very smart, just misunderstood by his teachers.
related_quotes: I usually don’t know what is happening a lot during class…I am kinda late usually or not paying attention. After school I can copy the same notes from the class and ask questions more.
I know if I go to tutoring more my grade will get better. I just have to stop messing around when I go. My teacher doesn’t help the ones that are screwing around – I get kicked out a lot [laughing].

behavior_patterns.condition: During class or tutoring when expected to work
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Late usually or not paying attention, messing around, screwing around, getting kicked out a lot.
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Felt like he had a relationship with her, albeit somewhat professional
